anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or inefficiencies in processing.
AI subsystem shows no recent learning cycles, zero average confidence, and no opportunities generated, suggesting it might not be functioning as intended.
Trading metrics show no active trades and zero total profit/loss, which could indicate a lack of trading activity or issues with strategy execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and potentially restart the AI subsystem to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate the current trading strategies to ensure they are correctly configured and capable of executing trades.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load to identify and resolve the root cause.
recommendations.rationale: Sustained high CPU load can lead to degraded system performance, impacting user experience and system reliability.

recommendations.action: Restart and debug the AI subsystem to ensure it is operational and contributing to trading decisions.
